-- GENERIC V8.33 WHOLE-PROGRAM KAREL CANDIDATE — PASS100
-- COMPILER-ELIGIBLE SOURCE CANDIDATE. Synthetic names may differ; no robot deployment/safety claim is made.
-- PC-resident global/routine names are exact; local/formal names are synthetic when source names are absent.
-- Header directives are emitted only for compiler-roundtrip-proved V8.33 config images.

PROGRAM BYTEPROBE
%STACKSIZE = 65535
%PRIORITY = 65535
%NOLOCKGROUP
VAR
  G1 : XYZWPR
  G2 : XYZWPR
  G3 : XYZWPR

-- LOCAL ROUTINE FORWARD DECLARATIONS (synthetic formal names)
ROUTINE R(P1 : STRING; P2 : STRING; P3 : XYZWPR; P4 : XYZWPR; P5 : XYZWPR) FROM BYTEPROBE

ROUTINE R
VAR
  L1 : ARRAY[1] OF INTEGER
  L2 : ARRAY[14] OF STRING[8]
BEGIN
  L2[1]=P1
  L2[2]=P2
  -- STRUCTURAL_PC line 12 opcodes [7F] marker_code=56
END R

BEGIN
  R('A', 'B', G1, G2, G3)
  -- STRUCTURAL_PC line 15 opcodes [7F] marker_code=118
END BYTEPROBE
